    "testCaseID": "POS-001",
    "title": "Validate successful LTE attach and detach procedure with single UE under excellent radio conditions",
    "description": "Verify that a single UE can successfully perform LTE attach and detach procedures 10 consecutive times under excellent radio conditions as per 3GPP TS 23.401 specifications.",
    "preconditions": [
      "Setup single isolated LTE cell with no inter-cell interference",
      "Place one stationary UE under excellent LTE RSRP conditions as defined in Clause 4.6",
      "All other cells powered off",
      "End-to-end LTE setup operational with no connectivity issues"
    ],
    "testSteps": [
      "Connect to the LTE network management interface using `SSH admin@<IP>`",
      "Configure the test environment as per the test configuration and record parameters",
      "Start logging call flow and signaling messages",
      "Power ON the UE to initiate LTE attach",
      "Wait and monitor for attach complete confirmation in logs",
      "Verify UE is attached to the correct cell (check PCI, Global eNB ID, ARFCN)",
      "Power OFF the UE to initiate detach",
      "Wait and monitor for detach accept confirmation in logs",
      "Repeat attach and detach steps 9 more times (total 10 iterations)",
      "Stop and save all test logs"
    ],
    "expectedResults": [
      "Attach success rate is 100% over 10 iterations",
      "Detach success rate is 100% over 10 iterations",
      "Attach latency is measured and minimum, average, maximum values recorded",
      "All signaling messages conform to 3GPP TS 23.401 attach and detach procedures",
      "UE is correctly attached to configured LTE cell parameters in all iterations"
    ],
    "postconditions": [
      "Test logs saved and KPIs recorded in test report"
    ],
    "commandsUsed": [
      "SSH admin@<IP>"
    ],
    "verificationMethods": [
      "Analyze call flow and signaling message logs",
      "Check UE logs or applications for cell attachment details",
      "Validate RSRP values meet excellent radio condition criteria"
    ],
    "category": "POSITIVE TESTING"
  },
